1.w: Why, O YHWH, do You stand far off? Do You hide in times of distress?

2.w: In [his] arrogance, the wicked hotly pursue the afflicted; may they be caught in the schemes that they have devised!

3.w: For the wicked one boasts over the desire of his heart, and he blesses a dishonest gainer; he has despised YHWH.

4.w: The wicked one, in the height of his face, does not inquire; there is no God [in] any of his thoughts.

5.w: His paths are firm at every time; Your judgments [are] on high before him, [and] all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

6.w: He has said in his heart, “I shall not be moved—from generation to generation—to whom [will be] no adversity.”

7.w: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; under his tongue [are] trouble and iniquity.

8.w: He sits in an ambush of the villages; in the hidden places he kills the innocent one; his eyes look stealthily on the helpless.

9.w: He lies in wait in the hidden place, like a lion in his lair; he lies in wait to catch the afflicted one; he catches the afflicted one by drawing him into his net.

10.w: He is crushed; he bows down, and the hapless one falls by his strength.

11.w: He has said in his heart, “God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will not see [it] forever.”

12.w: Arise, O YHWH! O God, lift up Your hand! You must not forget the afflicted ones.

13.w: Upon what does the wicked spurn God? He has said in his heart, “You will not call [me] to account.”

14.w: Indeed you You have seen; You regard trouble and grief, to give [it] into Your hand. The hapless one leaves himself to You; for You are the One helping the fatherless.

15.w: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer! Seek out his wickedness, [until] none is found.

16.w: YHWH [is] King forever and ever; the nations have perished from His land.

17.w: The desire of the afflicted ones You have heard, O YHWH; You will make firm their hearts; You will incline Your ear,

18.w: to do justice for the fatherless and oppressed; he shall not continue anymore to terrorize—the man from the earth,
